notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 101–484, § 2, Oct. 31, 1990, 104 Stat. 1167, which set out definitions, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 101–484, § 1, Oct. 31, 1990, 104 Stat. 1167, provided that Pub. L. 101–484, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Ponca Restoration Act”.
